# NutriThrive

> Lab-tested moringa powder, Darjeeling black tea, dried curry leaves and handmade moringa soap. Packed and shipped from Truganina, Melbourne VIC. Food supplements, not medical advice.

## Products

- [Moringa Leaf Powder](https://nutrithrive.com.au/products/moringa-powder/): Shade-dried, NMI lab-tested in Australia, $11/100g or $21.50/200g (400g bundle $35). Free AU shipping at $79. No fillers, no additives.
- [Darjeeling Black Tea](https://nutrithrive.com.au/products/black-tea/): First-flush Darjeeling, rich muscatel aroma, $7.50/100g.
- [Dried Curry Leaves](https://nutrithrive.com.au/products/curry-leaves/): Whole-leaf, shade-dried, $7/30g.
- [Moringa Soap](https://nutrithrive.com.au/products/moringa-soap/): Handmade lavender bar with moringa, $7.
- [Wellness Combo Pack](https://nutrithrive.com.au/products/combo-pack/): 100g moringa powder + 30g dried curry leaves, $17.
- [Gift Pack](https://nutrithrive.com.au/products/gift-pack/): 100g moringa, 100g black tea, 30g curry leaves, 95g moringa lavender soap — $35.
- [All products](https://nutrithrive.com.au/products/): Full catalogue with pricing.
